features: Triple-Mode Connectivity: Switch effortlessly between three connections — a low-latency 2.4 GHz USB receiver and two independent Bluetooth 5.1 channels (BT1 & BT2) — using a single switch on the underside, for plug-and-play pairing across laptop, desktop, and phone.
Rechargeable 400 mAh Battery with Live Display: Charges fully in approximately 2 hours and features a real-time four-grid LED indicator, so you can check battery level at a glance.
1600 DPI Optical Sensor: Delivers smooth, precise cursor tracking and accurate text selection for everyday work, browsing, and gaming.
Smart Sleep Mode: Automatically sleeps after 5 minutes of inactivity to save power, and wakes instantly in 1 second with a single click.

Two Dedicated Shortcut Keys: A Copy/Paste key (single-click copy, double-click paste) and a Return-to-Desktop key (single-click show desktop, double-click lock screen) put your most-used actions one click away.
Sleek Transparent Design: A clear, ergonomic shell shows off the internal mechanism while sitting comfortably in hand, equally suited to office and gaming use.
Powerful Magnetic Design: A magnetic receiver slot holds the USB dongle securely in place, giving long-lasting stability with zero wobble.
